body.v: Your ThisIsTea password expires at 17:00 today. Sign in now to keep your current password.

hotspots.explain: Read a web address from the right: the owner is the last name before the first slash, and here that is secure-login.example. The thisistea.example on the left is only decoration.
"Expires today" is a deadline made up to rush you.
A 17:00 cut-off leaves little time to check. Real password changes do not come with a same-day threat.
The link has the same trick: thisistea.example.secure-login.example belongs to secure-login.example.

who.prompt: Who is really writing to you? Look at the address, not just the name.
who.answer: Someone using ThisIsTea's name. The real owner of the address is secure-login.example. thisistea.example on its left is just decoration.
choices: Someone whose real domain is secure-login.example

emotion.prompt: What feeling is this email trying to create?
emotion.answer: Fear and hurry: lose your password at 17:00 today unless you act now.
choices: Fear and hurry from a same-day deadline

ask.prompt: What exactly does it want you to do?
ask.answer: Sign in through the link to 'keep' your password, which would hand it to the sender.

verify.prompt: How can you check through a channel you control?
verify.answer: Do not use the link. Open ThisIsTea yourself, from a bookmark or by typing the address, or ask IT on a channel you know.
choices: Click the link and check the page
Open ThisIsTea yourself, by typing its address

actions.label: Open ThisIsTea yourself by typing its address, and ask IT if in doubt
actions.consequence: Your password does not expire. The email was fake.

actions.label: Click the link and sign in
actions.consequence: The page copies your login for the scammer.

actions.label: Reply to the helpdesk address
actions.consequence: Your reply goes to the scammer, who is happy to keep chatting.

actions.label: Report it to IT so they can warn your colleagues
actions.consequence: Good call. Your report may protect the colleague who got the same email.

attacker_reveal: You read the address from the left and saw thisistea.example. I put the real owner at the other end... and added a 17:00 deadline. Read from the right.
